data.background:
AnimeJapan, the world's largest annual anime event, held annually in Tokyo, and Crunchyroll are partnering to support the next generation of anime creative talent with the New Creator Awards. Japanese students can submit short films for a chance to win prizes up to 1 million yen and have their work streamed globally on Crunchyroll. This work is the winning entry for the inaugural award ceremony.



(Source: Crunchyroll)
data.synopsis:
1. Police Men
A human dramedy set in Kyoto about three police officers with very different personalities who sometimes work together and sometimes butt heads as they run toward the shared goal of catching the bad guy.

2. One with the City
Day-to-day life in Aichi is peaceful, and there are people behind that peace who keep its cities safe. The moment they put on the uniform, they transform from "the protected" to "the protectors." This short animation shows the police officers who support the safety and future of the people.

3. Offbeat
Leo spends his days feeling robotic and oppressed. Soon enough, he starts to feel that his existence is meaningless, as if he's been tossed into the trash can like a piece of garbage. But then he reunites with the one thing he loved most that he had given up on. From that moment onward, Leo begins to remember the joy of living.

4. Requiem for the Endless Night
An elderly man lives alone on another planet after an apocalyptic disaster. After spending thirty years searching in vain for signals from other survivors, he decides to return to his home world, embarking on one final homecoming to mourn all those who were lost.

5. Magokoro Musubi: Gyutto Komeru Omoi
Our story follows Shio Musubi, a lightly salted rice ball. He meets several other types of "musubi" rice balls in the park, but all of their unique characteristics make him feel like there's nothing special about him. Then, right at the end of his travels, the scene he sees at a little old lady's house makes him realize something very important.

6. Traces of Summer 
Two years after moving to Tokyo from the countryside, the hustle and bustle of the big city has wiped the calm from our heroine's soul. Then she receives a message that prompts her to pay a visit to her hometown. There, the smells and memories of summer restart something in her heart that had stopped. Her journey follows the tiny traces of summer as her heart quietly moves forward.

7. Live in Red
Somewhere on a vast red planet, there sits a city enclosed by a barrier. Outside the barrier, dust storms and harsh winds rage. Suddenly, a giant robot breaks through the barrier and infiltrates the city…

(Source: Crunchyroll)

data.background: The second short film, after Kiyotaka Oshiyama's "Aka no Kioku" ("Red Memory"), produced by the Fukushima Map Friends Association. The aim of this project is the delivery of the comprehensive information magazine "Fukushima Map" to a wider audience.
data.synopsis:
The short film tells the story of a French philosopher named Sophie, who visits Fukushima Prefecture for the first time to attend a friend's wedding. Sophie loses her way in Fukushima, but a mysterious "friend" and a "map" appear before her, and she follows their lead making detours and stops. Little by little, Sophie realizes that everything in Fukushima is a "culture" that has been created by someone and has been passed down through generations.

(Source: ANN)

data.synopsis:
The anion and cation orbs were stolen by a mysterious wolf pack, pointing the finger of danger directly at the Strange Realm. The sheep and wolves tracked them down to the Strange Realm, only to discover that Handsome Guy and Black General had also been captured and taken to the Inner Earth beneath it. To rescue the two eggs, the sheep and wolves resolutely set off for the Inner Earth. In their adventures through the layers of the Inner Earth, the sheep and wolves met various explorers, fought against unknown monsters, and braved mysterious dangers. After countless battles and intrigues, the sheep and wolves finally uncovered the conspiracy of the ruthless preserved egg factory, rescued Handsome Guy and Black General, and, with the help of the two eggs, thwarted the crisis caused by the wolf pack, protecting the peace of the Inner Earth.

data.synopsis:
The future. Winter. Space travel is no longer a dream. A once-thriving film studio faces bankruptcy. The enormous compound, with structures ranging from the Great Sphinx of Giza to the Forbidden City, is now completely covered in snow and stripped of its former glory. Zha, a lonely janitor, tends to this forgotten place, with only a cat that used to perform in films for company. Running out of money, the studio owner gives him a VR headset as partial compensation. Zha is immediately drawn into the virtual world and embarks on a romantic journey with a female player who invites him on a trip to the moon. Meanwhile, the studio, which is about to close permanently, is temporarily brought back to life when a film crew arrives to shoot an alien invasion movie on the expansive backlot – with the studio’s actual destruction slated to be shot as the movie’s final showdown. 

(Source: Berlin International Film Festival)
